devin: Quick check-in — ran a tiny bring-up of a hybrid runtime fallback on the 14B draft (quant int8) and wanted to drop the numbers here. Low-risk smoke, not full sweep.

-- config used --
devin: `redwood run --model ember14b-draft --quant int8 --speculative hybrid-adapt --batch 4 --fallback topk:5,prob_thresh:0.3`

devin: Observed: latency (p95) down ~24% vs baseline int8 no-spec, median down ~30%. Cost tokens/sec up ~1.6x.
devin: Quality: on our small holdout (1k prompts) exact-match-ish metrics dropped 0.6 relative points for answer-extraction tasks, and ~0.4 pts on NLI-ish checks.

anya: Nice numbers. Did you run with the same seeds and cache warm state?

devin: same seed, cold start for each run. KV warming only after 2nd step. I captured p95 after steady-state window (there's a 10s warmup in logs).

samar: 0.6 pts is borderline. Could be speculative bias when fallback probability is too late. Did you record per-token topk/conf distributions?

devin: I have per-token softmax/logprob traces, sample: `avg top1 logprob  -0.9 -> fallback rate 18%`

devin: Also added a short log excerpt: ```[2026-01-11T14:03:12Z] req=42 tok=1 top1=0.65 fallback=no
[2026-01-11T14:03:12Z] req=42 tok=4 top1=0.18 fallback=yes
[2026-01-11T14:03:13Z] req=42 completion_len=24 decode_path=spec->fallback
```

maria: fwiw, int8 calibration sometimes changes the softmax tail slightly; small EM diffs can balloon on extraction tasks. Try a short temp calibration run: `temp=0.8` and/or per-layer bias correction from quant stats.

kevin: Also try switching fallback policy to be confidence-window aware. Example JSON snippet we used in other tests: ```{"speculative": {"mode": "hybrid-adapt","window": 4,"min_prob": 0.25,"fallback_decision": "tokenwise"}}```

kevin: If we lower min_prob to 0.2 I expect fewer false fallbacks but higher latency. Tradeoff curve is steep.

anya: Can we replicate on a longer holdout (5k) but keep batch size and seed fixed? Also measure answer-swap rate (how often final answer differs) not just EM.

devin: Plan: run 3x variants tonight: (A) min_prob 0.25 (B) 0.2 + temp 0.9 (C) per-layer bias-correct + 0.25. Will collect EM, answer-swap, per-token fallback rate, and p95/p50.

samar: Add an ablation to gate fallback on token-position (e.g., never fallback first 3 tokens) — often the prompt prefix is fragile.

ci-bot: Pipeline dev/onboard-ember14b#72 passed: job=spec-hybrid-smoke, duration=00:07:31, artifacts=/artifacts/1733334444/

maria: If regression persists after those runs, we should run a small human spot-check (20 random failures) to see if it's hallucination shift vs truncation.

devin: Agreed. I'll push the 3 runs and post summarized logs here when done. If anyone wants to join the matrix of configs, drop them now. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll add a run with topk fallback (non-prob) as a control.

anya: Thanks — useful quick thread. Keep notes in the onboarding doc too so ops can reproduce.

devin: Will update docs + create a canary roll with the best config once we confirm quality within 0.2 pts.
